en.thirdPartyCentralizedControl: Upload to the third-party centralized control platform
en.tipUploadPath: The upload path format is "address/path", such as"ftp://192.168.1.10/record"
en.minDuration: Upload duration must be at least 10 minutes.
en.tipUploadWay:
1. Idle: Upload when no other tasks are running.
2. Continuous: Upload while unsynchronized files remain.
3. Scheduled: Upload during the specified time window.

zh.filmOnly: 只上传电影模式的录像
zh.thirdPartyCentralizedControl: 上传到第三方集控平台
zh.uploadByUsername: 根据用户名上传到不同目录
zh.tipUploadPath: 上传路径格式为“地址/路径”，如“ftp://192.168.1.10/record”
zh.tipUploadWay:
1. 闲时上传：无其他任务时上传。
2. 连续上传：有未同步文件时上传。
3. 定时上传：在指定时段上传。
